values.name: Anechoic
values.definition: Completely black fluid without internal echoes; sound transmission is enhanced posterior to fluid (typical simple cyst).

values.name: Low-level / Ground-glass
values.definition: Homogeneous fine particulate internal echoes throughout the cyst cavity without acoustic streaming (pathognomonic of endometrioma).

values.name: Hemorrhagic / Lacy reticular
values.definition: Internal fine fibrinous strands creating a web/fishnet meshwork with non-vascular retracting clot (typical corpus luteum hemorrhage).

values.name: Mixed / Hyperechoic components
values.definition: Heterogeneous fluid with floating echogenic lines and dots (dermoid mesh) or fluid-fluid interface (typical mature cystic teratoma).

values.name: Mucinous / Low-level heterogeneous
values.definition: Dependent fine echoes or multilocular honey-comb appearance (typical mucinous cystadenoma).

values.name: No septa
values.definition: Cyst is strictly unilocular.

values.name: Thin smooth septum
values.definition: Complete septum crossing cavity with thickness < 3 mm and smooth margins.

values.name: Thick or irregular septum
values.definition: Complete septum with thickness ≥ 3 mm or nodular irregular contours.

values.name: Incomplete septum
values.definition: Septum arising from one wall that does not reach the opposite wall (Cogwheel sign / waist sign in hydrosalpinx).

values.name: None
values.definition: No parenchymal solid tissue present inside or on the wall of the cyst.

values.name: Small solid component
values.definition: Solid tissue with largest diameter < 7 mm (IOTA Rule B2).

values.name: Papillary projection 1-3
values.definition: 1 to 3 solid projections with height ≥ 3 mm arising from the wall/septum.

values.name: Papillary projections ≥ 4
values.definition: 4 or more discrete papillary projections (IOTA Rule M3).

values.name: Predominantly solid mass
values.definition: Solid component comprises ≥ 80% of the entire lesion.

values.name: Acoustic enhancement
values.definition: Increased brightness distal to fluid-filled structures due to low ultrasound attenuation.

values.name: Acoustic shadowing
values.definition: Bands of reduced echo distal to sound-attenuating structures (calcifications, dense collagen/fibrous tissue, sebaceous plugs). Strongly indicates benignity.

values.name: No posterior acoustic change
values.definition: Equal sound transmission through the lesion compared to surrounding stroma.

values.name: Avascular
values.definition: No color Doppler signal detectable inside the mass or on the cyst wall.

values.name: Minimal flow
values.definition: Only 1-2 small color pixels or subtle vessel segments visible with PRF 0.3-0.6 kHz.

values.name: Moderate flow
values.definition: Definite vessel branches with pulsatile flow visible in septa or solid areas.

values.name: Strong / Chaotic flow
values.definition: Extensive chaotic vascular network with low-resistance neo-angiogenesis signals.
